name: Fork of the Crimson Soul
storyline:
Earth is home to some incredible beings, from humans to animals and of course food people.

Enter Furter Sosis, he's a badass, slightly stupid, headband wearing hotdog who wields the legendary Fork of the Crimson Soul. One day believing his girlfriend Francine cheated on him he rushes out of the house to get revenge on the alleged perpetrator. He meets up with his friend Karemaru at a bar and after a long series of events he gets into a huge fight with the police and has no choice but to defeat them. After Furter beats the chief officer he's subdued and sent to prison but not all hope is lost. The demo ends at this point but there's far more to the story. After winning the prison's fighting tournament Furter and Karemaru are introduced to G.Lato and Giri Omusubi an ice cream and onigiri duo who run a vigilante organization. Furter and Karemaru are sent on ninja missions all around the world. Furter reconciles with Francine, and battles powerful foes like aliens, a crazy stalker, robots, and an evil tyrant. Along his way he will uncover the truth about his fork and what it truly means to be a shinobi.
summary: Fork of the Crimson Soul is a stylish character action game featuring food characters in absurd and badass life or death battles. You take control of Furter, a hot-headed fork wielding hotdog who slashes his way through heaps of enemies he's fairly quick and has a wide range of moves.
